_comment: LPC generator recipes (the URL hash from the web generator). Rebuild with: node tools/lpc/build_character.js <key> <out dir>, then copy sheet.png to 'output' and credits.* to 'credits'.

kid.notes: Teen body (he's 13), small head, messy chestnut hair, red longsleeve, blue jeans, white sneakers. Red pops against the Big Yard greens.

dad.notes: 43, the kid's dad (the 1995 boy). Same chestnut hair and light skin as the kid on purpose: the photo reveal depends on the family resemblance. Beard, green button-up, charcoal pants.

maya.notes: 13, the kid's best friend. Ponytail, lavender longsleeve, jeans.

dex.notes: 14, made the dare. Blond cowlick (not messy: the kid's hair is messy), charcoal tee, navy pants, black shoes.
